I have 300 hours in CS:GO which I played since its release and 100 in Insurgency. At some point I got bored of CS and am enjoying Insurgency more, at the moment.

What I like in both games:

  • Intensity. You respawn slowly, fights are quick.

  • Objective based, tactical gameplay. Winning matters over kills. A frag, smoke or flashbang in the right place at the right time can be a game changer.

  • Gunplay. Guns have recoil, I think it makes fps games more satisfying.

Pros of CS, cons of Insurgency:

  • CS has tighter controls and a more competitive focus. Insurgency can be a bit wonky sometimes. For example, if you go prone in Insurgency, there is a short moment where you can't shoot, to discourage "dolphin diving". If you reload and stand up from being prone, the reload is cancelled, same with sprinting. This can be frustrating.

  • CS has a bigger playerbase and consequently a bigger competitive scene and a more even ranked matchmaking. Teams in Insurgency can be quite imbalanced, but if you're winning, then who cares.

  • Since the maps are bigger in Insurgency and you have lower tolerance for bullets, often it will seem like you were randomly shot and you will have no idea where you were shot from. That takes some getting used to. It can feel like you have a low-impact on the game. The maps aren't that good for smaller scale games.

Pros of Insurgency:

  • More immersive. The sound quality is better. Insurgency is very satisfying in a way that is hard to quantify. You feel more like you are in the game.

  • Aim-down sights works well, with metal sights and low powered scopes being faster and giving peripheral vision, while high powered scopes give you zoom, but are less practical in mid-close engagements, with higher aim time and less peripheral vision.

  • More variation in game modes with more players, playstyles and bigger maps. Good fun.

  • Insurgency has a good coop mode vs. Bots. I like playing that as a warmup or when I want to have an easy game.

  • Mostly players are silent, but when they talk, generally I find them less annoying than in CS

  • Recently, there has been the new Day of Infamy WW2 mod for Insurgency that is worth checking out.

I like both games. CS is a time-proven classic, while Insurgency innovates and tries new things with exciting and satisfying results, in my opinion.
